title: ConnectWise PSA (unofficial)
auth: Basic: the company ID and an API member's public key as the username, the private key as the password, plus the ConnectWise clientId and API host as connection settings
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Not run against ConnectWise PSA: there was no instance to test with. On 2026-10-21 a renamed copy imported into a Sophos Fusion tenant, exported again, and was deleted. Request and response shapes follow ConnectWise's published API models; the JSON Patch form of a status change and the ticket link format are untested.
